name: Kushida Ryouichi
source:
In an attempt to get Hatanaka to stop his affair with Gangi, Kushida attempts to use magic to transform into her to have it called off, but unfortunately, the spell is botched and he transforms into Tsukamoto instead.

[Right hair is eaten.]
